_about: Commune lists of Law 84-09 (1984) for the 31 wilayas whose composition no later law restated, transcribed by hand from the scanned JO (no text layer; no OCR engine available), plus Ordinance 97-14 (1997) which moved 24 communes to Alger. Each item is mapped to upstream row ids: match "name" = same commune by name (spelling variants allowed); "renamed" = different current name, paired by the ONS commune code (wilaya*100 + 1984 list position) carried by upstream; "split" = one 1984 commune that is two communes today. See artifacts/GEO-6/report.md.

law_84_09.title: Loi n° 84-09 du 4 février 1984 relative à l'organisation territoriale du pays
law_84_09.art3: « Art. 3. — La nouvelle organisation territoriale du pays comprend quarante-huit (48) wilayas et mille cinq cent quarante (1540) communes. » (p. 102)
law_84_09.method: Manual transcription from 300 dpi page renders (pdftoppm); every list length equals its declared count.
